title: Linh's Online Confidence
segments: Linh had just joined her 'Star Sketchers' online group. A new member, 'Art_Lover99,' quickly sent her a private message. It asked for her home address and school name. Linh felt a sudden chill. This was not the friendly welcome she had imagined. She stared at the screen, feeling uneasy and unsure what to do next.

Because of this, Linh's worried expression didn't go unnoticed. Her older brother, Quan, walked into her room and saw her staring at the screen. He asked what was wrong. Hesitantly, Linh showed him the message from 'Art_Lover99', detailing the request for her home address. Quan's eyes narrowed. He immediately recognized it as a potential online scam.

Because of this, Quan patiently explained. He showed Linh common online scam tactics, like asking for personal details too soon. He then demonstrated how to verify a user's profile for red flags. 'Always check their activity and friends,' he advised. Next, he showed her how to report suspicious messages and block 'Art_Lover99' to ensure her safety online.

After that, Linh felt much more confident. A few days later, another message appeared, this time from 'Game_Master22', asking for her password to 'unlock special items'. Remembering Quan’s advice, Linh immediately noticed the red flags. She didn't hesitate. Linh confidently reported the suspicious user and blocked them, protecting her account and feeling proud of her quick action.

Because of this, Linh excitedly told Quan about blocking 'Game_Master22'. 'I remembered everything you taught me!' she exclaimed, beaming with pride. Quan smiled, genuinely proud of her quick thinking. 'You're becoming an online safety expert!' he praised. Linh felt a significant surge of confidence, realizing she could now navigate online spaces safely and independently.

From that day on, Linh approached her online hobby group with newfound confidence. She actively participated, sharing her ideas and making new friends, always remembering Quan’s lessons. She even helped another new member identify a suspicious message, sharing her own experience. Linh knew she was now truly an online safety expert, ready for any digital adventure.
endWrap: Linh's journey showed that with knowledge and support, anyone can become confident and safe in the digital world. Her online adventures had just begun!
